Thus, O lady of excellent countenance, many auspicious ones carried these and other things and reached the place along with Sāvitrī.

## \|\| 1.165.52 \|\|

*sāvitrīmāgatāṃ dṛṣṭvā bhītastatra puraṃdaraḥ \|*  
*adhomukhaḥ sthito brahmā kimeṣā māṃ vadiṣyati \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. On seeing that Sāvitrī had come Purandara (Indra) became afraid. Brahmā remained looking down wondering what she would say to him.

## \|\| 1.165.53 \|\|

*trapānvitau viṣṇurudrau sarve cānye dvijātayaḥ \|*  
*sabhāsadastathā bhītāstathaivānye divaukasaḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. Viṣṇu and Rudra became bashful and shame-faced. So too were the Brāhmaṇas and the members of the assembly. The other Heaven-dwellers became frightened.

## \|\| 1.165.54-55 \|\|

*putrapautrā bhāgineyā mātulā bhrātarastathā \|*  
*ṛtavo nāma ye devā devānāmapi devatāḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

*vilakṣāstu tathā sarve sāvitrī kiṃ vadiṣyati \|*  
*brahmavākyāni vācyāni kiṃ nu vai gopakanyayā \|\| 55 \|\|*

54-55. Sons and grandsons, nephews and uncles and brothers, the Devas named Ṛtus and the chiefs of Devas were abashed and disconcerted wondering what Sāvitrī would say. They enquired whether the Vedic passages were to be recited by the daughter of a cowherd.

## \|\| 1.165.56-58 \|\|

*maunībhūtāstu śṛṇvānāḥ sarveṣāṃ vadatāṃ giraḥ \|*  
*adhvaryuṇā samāhūtā nāgatā varavarṇinī \|\| 56 \|\|*

*śakreṇānyā tathā'nītā dattā sā viṣṇunā svayam \|*  
*anumoditā ca rudreṇa pitrā dattā svayaṃ tathā \|\| 57 \|\|*

*kathaṃ sā bhavitā yajñaḥ samāptiṃ vā kathaṃ vrajet \|*  
*evaṃ cintayatāṃ teṣāṃ praviṣṭā kamalālayā \|\| 58 \|\|*

56-58. When all of them were speaking some words the listeners kept quiet. ‘She was summoned by the Adhvaryu but the lady of fair complexion (Sāvitrī) did not come. Another girl was brought by Śakra and was offered (in marriage) by Viṣṇu himself. It was approved by Rudra and she was offered by the father himself. What will she do now and how will the Yajña come to a conclusion?’ Even as they were worriedly thinking thus, Kamalālayā (Sāvitrī) entered.

## \|\| 1.165.59 \|\|

*vṛto brahmā bhāryayā sa ṛtvigbhirvedapāragaiḥ \|*  
*hūyante cāgnayastatra brāhmaṇairvedapāragaiḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. Along with his wife Brahmā was invited by the Ṛtviks well-versed in the Vedas. Homas were performed in the fires there by the Brāhmaṇas who had mastered the Vedas.

## \|\| 1.165.60 \|\|

*patnīśāle tathā gopī raupyaśṛṃgā samekhalā \|*  
*kṣaumavastraparīdhānā dhyāyantī parameśvaram \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. In the Patnīśālā (wife’s chamber) the cowherdess was seated meditating on the great Lord. She had a silver horn and girdle. She was clad in silky fabric.

## \|\| 1.165.61 \|\|

*pativratā patiprāṇā prādhānyena niveśitā \|*  
*kṛpānvitā viśālākṣī tejasā bhāskaropamā \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. She was loyal to her husband considering him to be her vital airs. She was seated there as an important person. She was wide-eyed and compassionate. By her splendour, she could be compared to the Sun.

## \|\| 1.165.62 \|\|

*dyotayaṃtī sadastatra sūryasyeva yathā prabhā \|*  
*jvalamānastathā vahnirbhramaṃte cartvijastathā \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. Like the lustre of the Sun, she was illuminating the assembly there. The sacrificial fire blazed and Ṛtviks moved about.

## \|\| 1.165.63 \|\|

*paśūnāmavadānāni gṛhṇaṃti dvijasattamāḥ \|*  
*prāptā bhāgārthino devā vilaṃbasamayo'bhavat \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. Excellent Brāhmaṇas held parts of the beasts (sacrificial animals). Seeking their shares, Devas arrived. It was already late.

## \|\| 1.165.64 \|\|

*kālahīnaṃ na kartavyaṃ kṛtaṃ na phaladaṃ bhavet \|*  
*vedeṣvayamadhīkāro dṛṣṭaḥ sarvo manīṣibhiḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. Nothing should be done after the prescribed time. If it is not performed thus it cannot yield fruit. The whole of this reference (topic) is to be seen in the Vedas by learned men.

## \|\| 1.165.65-66 \|\|

*pravargye kriyamāṇe tu brāhmaṇairvedapāragaiḥ \|*  
*kṣīradvaye hūyamāne maṃtreṇādhvaryuṇā tathā \|\| 65 \|\|*

*upahūtopahūtena āgateṣu dvijanmasu \|*  
*kriyamāṇe tathā bhakṣye dṛṣṭvā devī krudhānvitā \|*  
*uvāca devī brahmāṇaṃ sadomadhye tu mauninam \|\| 66 \|\|*

65-66. As the Pravargya rite was being performed by the Brāhmaṇas well-versed in the Vedas, when Kṣīradvaya (two drops of milk) was being consigned to the fire by the Adhvaryu uttering the Mantra, when all the Brāhmaṇas had assembled after being summoned severally (one calling the other and the other calling some other successively) and the foodstuffs were being prepared, the fair lady saw all these and became furious. She spoke to Brahmā seated silently in the middle of the assembly:

## \|\| 1.165.67-74 \|\|

*kimevaṃ budhyate deva kṛtametadviceṣṭitam \|*  
*māṃ parityajya yaḥ kāmātkṛtavānasi kilbiṣam \|\| 67 \|\|*

*na tulyā pādarajasā samā sā'dhiśiraḥ kṛtā \|\| 68 \|\|*

*yadvadaṃti narāḥ sarve saṃgatāḥ sadasi sthitāḥ \|*  
*āścaryaṃ ca prabhūṇāṃ tu kurute yaṃ yamicchati \|\| 69 \|\|*

*bhavatā rūpalobhena kṛtaṃ karma vigarhitam \|\| 70 \|\|*

*na putreṣu kṛtā lajjā pautreṣu ca na te vibho \|*  
*kāmakārakṛtaṃ manye hyetatkarma vigarhitam \|\| 71 \|\|*

*pitāmaho'si devānāmṛṣīṇāṃ prapitāmahaḥ \|*  
*kathaṃ na te trapā jātā ātmanaḥ paśyatastanum \|\| 72 \|\|*

*lokamadhye kṛtaṃ hāsyamiha caiva vigarhitaḥ \|*  
*yadyeṣa te sthito bhāvastiṣṭha deva namo'stu te \|\| 73 \|\|*

*ahaṃ kathaṃ sakhīnāṃ tu darśayiṣyāmi vai mukham \|*  
*bhartrā me vihitā patnī kathametadahaṃ vade \|\| 74 \|\|*

67-74. “How did this idea occur to you, O Lord? Why \[???\] is misdeed committed? You have committed a sin in \[????ning\] me out of lust.

A (girl) who is not even equal to the dust of my foot, has been raised to your head by you!

All these who have assembled in the hall should explain this. It is surprising that those who exert authority do whatever they wish.

Out of your lust for a beautiful form, you have committed a despicable act.

O Lord, you did not feel ashamed in the presence of your sons and grandsons. I think this despicable deed was committed out of lust.

You are the grandfather of Devas and the great-grandfather of the sages. How was it that you were not ashamed to see your own body?

Something ridiculous has been committed in the presence of the people. Here itself you stand despised. If this is to be your idea, do remain so, O Lord. Obeisance to you!

How can I show my face to my companions? How am I to say, another wife has been brought by my husband?”

## \|\| 1.165.75 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*ṛtvigbhirahamājñapto dīkṣā kālo'tivartate \|*  
*patnīṃ vinā na homotra śīghraṃ patnīmihānaya \|\| 75 \|\|*

Brahmā said:

75\. I was commanded by the Ṛtviks:“The time of initiation is slipping away. No Homa is possible here without a wife. Fetch (your) wife quickly.”

## \|\| 1.165.76 \|\|

*śakreṇaiṣā samānītā dattā caivā'tha viṣṇunā \|*  
*gṛhītā ca mayā tvaṃ hi kṣamasvaikaṃ mayā kṛtam \|*  
*na cāparādhyaṃ bhūyo'nyaṃ kariṣye tava suvrate \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. This girl was brought by Śakra. She was offered to me by Viṣṇu and she was accepted by me. Do forgive me for this only misdeed of mine. O lady of excellent holy rites, I will not commit anything offensive any longer.

## \|\| 1.165.77-79 \|\|

*īśvara uvāca \|*  
*evamuktā tadā kruddhā brahmāṇaṃ śaptumudyatā \|*  
*yadi me'sti tapastaptaṃ guravo yadi toṣitāḥ \|\| 77 \|\|*

*sarvabrāhmaṇaśālāsu sthāneṣu vividheṣvapi \|*  
*na tu te brāhmaṇāḥ pūjāṃ kariṣyaṃti kadācana \|\| 78 \|\|*

*ṛte vai kārtikīmekāṃ pūjāṃ sāṃvatsarīṃ tava \|*  
*kariṣyaṃti dvijāḥ sarve satyenānena te śape \|*  
*etadbuddhvā na kopostu hato hanti na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 79 \|\|*

Īśvara said:

77-79. On being told thus, she became enraged and began to curse Brahmā. “If adequate penance has been performed by me, if the preceptors and the elders have been propitiated by me, Brāhmaṇas will never adore you (Brahmā) in any of the different kinds of holy spots, in any of the Brāhmaṇa assemblies.

Your sole annual worship will be the Kārttikī adoration which all the Brāhmaṇas will perform for you; nothing save this. I curse you with this truthful utterance. I solemnly aver this. You need not be angry on knowing this: Undoubtedly what is killed does kill.”

## \|\| 1.165.80 \|\|

*sāvitryuvāca \|*  
*bhobhoḥ śakra tvayānītā ābhīrī brahmaṇo'ntikam \|*  
*yasmādīdṛkkṛtaṃ karma tasmāttvaṃ lapsyase phalam \|\| 80 \|\|*

Sāvitrī said:

80\. Oh! O Śakra, a cowherdess was brought to Brahmā by you. Since such a thing as this has been perpetrated by you, you will surely get the fruit thereof.

## \|\| 1.165.81 \|\|

*yadā saṃgrāmamadhye tvaṃ sthātā śakra bhaviṣyasi \|*  
*tadā tvaṃ śatrubhirbaddho nītaḥ paramikāṃ daśām \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. When you will get involved in a battle, O Śakra, you shall be bound by the enemies and brought to a miserable plight.

## \|\| 1.165.82 \|\|

*akiṃcano naṣṭasutaḥ śatrūṇāṃ nagare sthitaḥ \|*  
*parābhavaṃ mahatprāpya acirādeva mokṣyase \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. You shall be stripped of all your possessions leaving nothing for you. Your son will perish. You will be (confined) in the city of your enemies. After meeting with great discomfiture, you may get released ere long.

## \|\| 1.165.83 \|\|

*śakraṃ śaptvā tadā devī viṣṇuṃ cā'tha vacobravīt \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. After cursing Śakra, the fair lady spoke these words to Viṣṇu:

## \|\| 1.165.84-86 \|\|

*guruvākyena te janma yadā martye bhavi ṣyati \|*  
*bhāryāvirahajaṃ duḥkhaṃ tadā tvaṃ tatra bhokṣyase \|\| 84 \|\|*

*hṛtāṃ śatrugaṇaiḥ patnīṃ pare pāre mahodadheḥ \|*  
*na ca tvaṃ jñāyase sītāṃ śokopahacetanaḥ \|\| 85 \|\|*

*bhrātrā saha parāṃ kāṣṭhāmāpadaṃ duḥkhitastathā \|*  
*paśūnāṃ caiva saṃyogaścirakālaṃ bhaviṣyati \|\| 86 \|\|*

84-86. “At the instance of a Guru (Preceptor) you will be born in the mortal world. Then you will experience the misery arising from separation from your wife. Without your knowledge your wife will be abducted and kept on the other shore of the great ocean. Your senses will be smitten by grief.

You will get maximum suffering along with your brother. You will become associated with beasts for a long time.”

## \|\| 1.165.87-89 \|\|

*tathā'ha rudraṃ kupitā yadā dāruvane sthitaḥ \|*  
*tadā te munayaḥ kruddhāḥ śāpaṃ dāsyaṃti te hara \|\| 87 \|\|*

*bhobhoḥ kāpālika kṣudra patnyo'smākaṃ jihīrṣasi \|*  
*tadetadbhūṣitaṃ liṃga bhūmau rudra patiṣyati \|\| 88 \|\|*

*vihīnaḥ pauruṣeṇa tvaṃ muniśāpācca pīḍitaḥ \|*  
*gaṃgātīre sthitā patnī sā tvāmāśvāsayiṣyati \|\| 89 \|\|*

87-89. Similarly the angry lady spoke to Rudra: “O Hara, while you are in Dāruvana, the infuriated sages will curse you (as follows). ‘Oh! O Kāpālika, O insignificant one, you desire to carry off our wives. Hence this accursed Liṅga (penis) of yours, O Rudra, will fall on the ground.’

Bereft of manliness, you shall be afflicted with the curse of the sages. Your wife stationed on the banks of Gaṅgā will console you.”

## \|\| 1.165.90-91 \|\|

*agne tvaṃ sarvabhakṣo'si pūrvaṃ putreṇa me kṛtaḥ \|*  
*bhrūṇahā dharma ityeṣa kathaṃ dagdhaṃ dahāmyaham \|\| 90 \|\|*

*jātavedasa rudrastvāṃ retasā plāvayiṣyati \|*  
*medhyeṣu ca kṛtajvālā jvālayā tvāṃ jvaliṣyati \|\| 91 \|\|*

90-91. “O Agni, formerly you were made by my son a Sarvabhakṣa ‘one eating everything’. One who kills a foetus is unrighteous. Why should I burn one already burnt.

O Jātavedasa (Fire-god), Rudra will flood you with semen. You will be scorched by the flames on holy substances.”

## \|\| 1.165.92 \|\|

*brāhmaṇānṛtvijaḥ sarvānsāvitrī hyaśapattadā \|\| 92 \|\|*

92\. Then Sāvitrī cursed all the Brāhmaṇas and the Ṛtviks:

## \|\| 1.165.93-95 \|\|

*pratigrahāgnihotrāśca vṛthā dārā vṛthāśramāḥ \|*  
*sadā kṣetrāṇi tīrthāni lobhādeva gamiṣyatha \|\| 93 \|\|*

*parānneṣu sadā tṛptā atṛptāḥ svagṛheṣu ca \|*  
*ayājyayājanaṃ kṛtvā kutsitasya pratigraham \|\| 94 \|\|*

*vṛthā dhanārjanaṃ kṛtvā vyavaścaiva tathā vṛthā \|*  
*mṛtānāṃ tena pretatvaṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 95 \|\|*

93-95. “You will always be going to holy spots and Tīrthas out of greed, taking Pratigraha (monetary gifts) for your Agnihotra sacrifice; thereby your wives and householdership will become futile.

You will be always pleased and satisfied on the foodstuffs served by others. You will be dissatisfied with your own household. You will perform Yajñas on behalf of those who are not eligible and deserving. You will accept Pratigraha from despicable persons. Your earning of wealth will be futile. Your endeavour will be futile. Hence there is no doubt about it that on death you will become Pretas (spirits, ghosts).”

## \|\| 1.165.96 \|\|

*evaṃ śakraṃ tathā viṣṇuṃ rudraṃ vai pāvakaṃ tathā \|*  
*brahmāṇaṃ brāhmaṇāṃścaiva sarvāṃstānaśapattadā \|\| 96 \|\|*

96\. Thus she cursed all: Śakra, Viṣṇu, Rudra, Pāvaka, Brahmā and all the Brāhmaṇas.

## \|\| 1.165.97 \|\|

*śāpaṃ dattvā tathā teṣāṃ tadā sāvasthitā sthirā \|\| 97 \|\|*

97\. After cursing she became calmed.

## \|\| 1.165.98 \|\|

*lakṣmīḥ prāha sakhīṃ tāṃ ca indrāṇī ca varānanā \|*  
*anyā devyastathā prāhuḥ sā'ha sthāsyāmi nātra vai \|*  
*tatra cāhaṃ gamiṣyāmi yatra śroṣye na tu dhvanim \|\| 98 \|\|*

98\. Lakṣmī then spoke to her friend (Sāvitrī). Indrāṇī the lady with excellent countenance spoke to her (Sāvitrī). So did the other Devīs. Then she (Sāvitrī) said:

“I will not stay here. I will go to that place where I will not hear this noise.”

## \|\| 1.165.99 \|\|

*tatastāḥ pramadāḥ sarvāḥ prayātāḥ svaṃ niketanam \|*  
*sāvitrī kupitā tāsāṃ punaḥ śāpāya codyatā \|\| 99 \|\|*

99\. Then all those young ladies went to their respective abodes. The infuriated Sāvitrī attempted once again to curse them:

## \|\| 1.165.100-102 \|\|

*yasmānmāṃ saṃparityajya gatāstā devayoṣitaḥ \|*  
*tāsāmapi tathā śāpaṃ pradāsye kupitā bhṛśam \|\| 100 \|\|*

*naikatra vāso lakṣmyāstu bhaviṣyati kadācana \|*  
*rudrāpi caṃcalā tāvanmūrkheṣu ca vasiṣyasi \|\| 101 \|\|*

*mleccheṣu parvatīyeṣu kutsite kuṣṭhite tathā \|*  
*vācāṭe cāvalipte ca abhiśaste durātmani \|*  
*evaṃvidhe nare tubhyaṃ vasatiḥ śāpakāritā \|\| 102 \|\|*

100-102. “Since these Deva-damsels have gone away leaving me alone, I am very angry. I shall curse them too.”

“Lakṣmī will never stay permanently in one place. Even if restrained, she will be very fickle and abide in houses of fools.

O Lakṣmī, by my curse I have restricted your residence to these persons: barbarians, mountain-dwellers, despicable ones, lepers, the talkative, the arrogant, the accursed, the wicked and persons of similar features.”

## \|\| 1.165.103 \|\|

*śāpaṃ dattvā tatastasyā indrāṇīmaśapattadā \|\| 103 \|\|*

103\. After cursing her she cursed Indrāṇī then.

## \|\| 1.165.104-106 \|\|

*tvaṣṭurvācā gṛhītendre patyau te duṣṭakāriṇi \|*  
*nahuṣāya gate rājye dṛṣṭvā tvāṃ yācayiṣyati \|\| 104 \|\|*

*ahamindraḥ kathaṃ caiṣā nopatiṣṭhati cālasā \|*  
*sarvāndevānhaniṣyāmi lapsye nāhaṃ śacīṃ yadi \|\| 105 \|\|*

*naṣṭā tvaṃ ca tadā śastā vane mahati duḥkhitā \|*  
*vasiṣyasi durācāre śāpena mama garvite \|\| 106 \|\|*

104-106. “O haughty Indrāṇī of evil actions, when Indra, your husband of wicked actions, is held at the instance of Tvaṣṭṛ and when the realm passes over to Nahuṣa, he will requisition you saying ‘I am Indra. Why does this idle damsel not serve me? If I do not get Śacī, I will kill all the Devas.’ At that time you will get lost and suffer in a great forest. You will be miserable by my curse.”

## \|\| 1.165.107 \|\|

*devabhāryāsu sarvāsu tadā śāpamayacchata \|\| 107 \|\|*

107\. Then she cursed all the wives of the Devas.

## \|\| 1.165.108 \|\|

*na cāpatyakṛtā prītiḥ sarvāsveva bhaviṣyati \|*  
*dahyamānā divārātrau vaṃdhyāśabdena duḥkhitāḥ \|\| 108 \|\|*

108\. “None of you all will ever get the delight of bearing a child. You will be burning day and night in your misery due to being called a barren woman.”

## \|\| 1.165.109 \|\|

*gaurīmevaṃ tathā śaptvā sā devī varavarṇinī \|*  
*uccai ruroda sāvitrī bhartṛ yajñādbahiḥ sthitā \|\| 109 \|\|*

109\. She similarly cursed Gaurī too. Then Sāvitrī the excellent lady of exquisite complexion, stood outside the sacrificial hall of her husband and lamented loudly.

## \|\| 1.165.110-111 \|\|

*rodamānā tu sā dṛṣṭā viṣṇunā ca prasāditā \|*  
*mā rodīstvaṃ viśālākṣi ehyāgaccha sadaḥ śubhe \|\| 110 \|\|*

*praviṣṭā ca śubhe yāge mekhalāṃ kṣaumavāsasī \|*  
*gṛhāṇa dīkṣāṃ brahmāṇi pādau te praṇame śubhe \|\| 111 \|\|*

110-111. She was seen lamenting by Viṣṇu and was consoled: “O splendid lady of large eyes, do not cry; do come to the assembly hall.

O splendid Brahmāṇī, participate in the sacrifice. Enter the excellent sacrificial hall and take up the girdle and the pair of silken cloths. Become initiated, O splendid lady; I bow down to your feet.”

## \|\| 1.165.112 \|\|

*evamuktā'bravīdenaṃ nāhaṃ kuryāṃ vacastava \|*  
*tatrāhaṃ ca gamiṣyāmi yatra śroṣye na ca dhvanim \|\| 112 \|\|*

112\. On being told thus she said to him “I will not do as you say. I will go there where I will not hear this noise.”

## \|\| 1.165.113 \|\|

*etāvaduktvā vyaramaduccaiḥ sthāne kṣitau sthitā \|\| 113 \|\|*

113\. After saying this much, she stopped and stood on a higher place on the ground.

## \|\| 1.165.114 \|\|

*viṣṇustadagrataḥ sthitvā baddhvā ca karasaṃpuṭam \|*  
*tuṣṭāva praṇato bhūtvā bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ \|\| 114 \|\|*

114\. Viṣṇu stood in front of her with palms joined in reverence. Bowing down with great devotion he eulogized thus:

## \|\| 1.165.115 \|\|

*viṣṇuruvāca \|*  
*namo'stu te mahādevi bhūrbhuvaḥsvastrayīmayi \|*  
*sāvitri durgatariṇi tvaṃ vāṇī saptadhā smṛtā \|\| 115 \|\|*

Viṣṇu said:

115\. Obeisance to you, O great goddess, identical with Bhūḥ, Bhuvaḥ, Svaḥ and the three Vedas. O Sāvitrī that enable one to cross the impassable (Saṃsāra). You are remembered as the seven-fold speech.

## \|\| 1.165.116 \|\|

*sarvāṇi stutiśāstrāṇi lakṣaṇāni tathaiva ca \|*  
*bhaviṣyā sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ tvaṃ tu devi namo'stu te \|\| 116 \|\|*

116\. All the sacred texts of eulogy as well as features thereof shall pertain to you. O goddess, obeisance to you.

## \|\| 1.165.117 \|\|

*śvetā tvaṃ śvetarūpāsi śaśāṃkena samānanā \|*  
*śaśiraśmiprakāśena hariṇorasi rājase \|*  
*divyakuṃḍalapūrṇābhyāṃ śravaṇābhyāṃ vibhūṣitā \|\| 117 \|\|*

117\. You are white (fair), white in form (complexion). Your countenance is similar to that of the moon. You shine on the bosom of a deer illuminated by the rays of the moon. You are embellished with the pair of ears fitted with divine earrings.

## \|\| 1.165.118 \|\|

*tvaṃ siddhistvaṃ tathā ṛddhiḥ kīrtiḥ śrīḥ saṃtatirmatiḥ \|*  
*saṃdhyā rātri prabhātastvaṃ kālarātristvameva ca \|\| 118 \|\|*

118\. You are Siddhi (Achievement). So also you are Ṛddhi (Prosperity), Kīrti (Fame), Śrī (Glory), Santati (Continuation of Progeny), Mati (Intellect), Sandhyā (Twilight), Rātri (Night); you are the Dawn and Kālarātri (Nightmare) is your own self.

## \|\| 1.165.119 \|\|

*karṣukāṇāṃ yathā sītā bhūtānāṃ dhāriṇī tathā \|*  
*evaṃ stuvaṃtaṃ sāvitrī viṣṇuṃ provāca suvratā \|\| 119 \|\|*

119\. Just as the land furrowed with a plough is to cultivators, the earth is to living beings, so also you sustain all living beings.

Even as he eulogized thus Sāvitrī of excellent holy rites spoke to Viṣṇu:

## \|\| 1.165.120 \|\|

*samyakstutā tvayā putra ajeyastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi \|*  
*avatāre sadā vatsa pitṛmātṛsu vallabhaḥ \|\| 120 \|\|*

120\. “Dear Son, I have been perfectly eulogized by you. You will become invincible. In your incarnations always you will endear yourself to your father and mother.

## \|\| 1.165.121 \|\|

*anena stavarājena stoṣyate yastu māṃ sadā \|*  
*sarvadoṣavinirmuktaḥ paraṃ sthānaṃ gamiṣyati \|\| 121 \|\|*

121\. He who eulogizes me with this excellent prayer shall always be rid of all defects. He shall attain the greatest region.

## \|\| 1.165.122 \|\|

*gaccha yajñaṃ ciraṃ tasya samāptiṃ naya putraka \|\| 122 \|\|*

122\. Do go, dear son, and get the Yajña concluded.

## \|\| 1.165.123 \|\|

*kurukṣetre prayāge ca bhaviṣye yajñakarmaṇi \|*  
*samīpagā sthitā bhartuḥ kariṣye tava bhāṣitam \|\| 123 \|\|*

123\. In the two future Yajñas at Kurukṣetra and Prayāga, I shall remain by the side of my husband and carry out your suggestion.”

## \|\| 1.165.124 \|\|

*evamukto gato viṣṇurbrahmaṇaḥ sada uttamam \|*  
*sāvitrī tu samāyātā prabhāse varavarṇini \|\| 124 \|\|*

124\. On being told thus, Viṣṇu went to the excellent chamber of Brahmā, O lady of excellent complexion. Sāvitrī came to Prabhāsa.

## \|\| 1.165.125 \|\|

*gatāyāmatha sāvitryāṃ gāyatrī vākyamabravīt \|\| 125 \|\|*

125\. When Sāvitrī departed, Gāyatrī spoke these words:

## \|\| 1.165.126-133 \|\|

*śṛṇvaṃtu munayo vākyaṃ madīyaṃ bhartṛsannidhau \|*  
*yadahaṃ vacmi saṃtuṣṭā varadānāya codyatā \|\| 126 \|\|*

*brahmāṇaṃ pūjayiṣyaṃti narā bhaktisamanvitāḥ \|*  
*teṣāṃ vastraṃ dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ dārāḥ saukhyaṃ sutāśca vai \|\| 127 \|\|*

*avicchinnaṃ tathā saukhyaṃ gṛhaṃ vai putrapautrikam \|*  
*bhuktvā'sau suciraṃ kālaṃ tato mokṣaṃ gamiṣyati \|\| 128 \|\|*

*śakrāhaṃ te varaṃ vacmi saṃgrāme śatrubhiḥ saha \|*  
*tadā brahmā mocayitā gatvā śatruniketanam \|\| 129 \|\|*

*saputraśatrunāśāttvaṃ lapsyase ca paraṃ mudam \|*  
*akaṃṭakaṃ mahadrājyaṃ trailokye te bhaviṣyati \|\| 130 \|\|*

*martyaloke yadā viṣṇo hyavatāraṃ kariṣyasi \|*  
*bhrātrā saha paraṃ duḥkhaṃ svabhāryā haraṇaṃ ca yat \|\| 131 \|\|*

*hatvā śatruṃ punarbhāryāṃ lapsyase surasannidhau \|*  
*gṛhītvā tāṃ punaḥ prājyaṃ rājyaṃ kṛtvā gamiṣyasi \|\| 132 \|\|*

*ekādaśa sahasrāṇi kṛtvā rājyaṃ punardivam \|*  
*khyātiste vipulā loke cānurāgo bhaviṣyati \|\| 133 \|\|*

126-133. “May the sages listen to my words which I utter in the presence of my husband. I am delighted and am ready to bestow boons.

If men adore Brahmā with devotion, they will get garments, wealth, grain, wives, happiness and sons. After enjoying happiness without any break, abode, sons and grandsons as well for a long time the devotee will attain salvation.

O Śakra, I proclaim this boon to you. In your fight with the enemies, Brahmā will go to the abode of the enemies and get you released. You will get the greatest happiness due to the death of the enemies along with their sons. You will rule over the three worlds without any thorn.

O Viṣṇu, when you incarnate in the mortal world and your wife will be abducted, you will have great misery along with your brother. You will then kill your enemy and regain your wife. After accepting her in the presence of Suras, you will rule over the flourishing kingdom. After reigning for eleven thousand years, you will go back to heaven. Your fame will be extensive all over the world and you will get the love and affection of the people.”

## \|\| 1.165.134 \|\|

*gāyatrī brāhmaṇāṃstāṃśca sarvānevābravīdidam \|\| 134 \|\|*

134\. Gāyatrī then spoke this to all those Brāhmaṇas:

## \|\| 1.165.135 \|\|

*yuṣmākaṃ prīṇanaṃ kṛtvā' tṛptiṃ yāsyaṃti devatāḥ \|*  
*bhavaṃto bhūmidevā vai sarve pūjyā bhaviṣyatha \|\| 135 \|\|*

135\. “Gods will become satisfied by propitiating you all. You are Devas of the earth. All of you will become adorable.

## \|\| 1.165.136 \|\|

*yuṣmākaṃ pūjanaṃ kṛtvā dattvā dānānyanekaśaḥ \|*  
*prāṇāyāmena caikena sarvametattariṣyatha \|\| 136 \|\|*

136.137. The Devas will go after worshipping you and distributing many gifts.

Especially in Prabhāsa you will perform the Japa of Gāyatrī, the mother of the Vedas, and will cross everything (difficulties) with a single Prāṇāyāma. O excellent Brāhmaṇas, you will never become defiled by the defects of Pratigraha. (acceptance of a Dāna).

## \|\| 1.165.158 \|\|

*indrāṇi nahuṣaḥ prāpya svargaṃ tvāṃ yācayiṣyati \|*  
*adṛṣṭvā tu hataḥ pāpo agastyavacanāddrutam \|\| 158 \|\|*

158\. If food is given at Puṣkara, all the Devas will be pleased. If one Brāhmaṇa is fed, it is as good as ten millions having been fed.

## \|\| 1.165.139 \|\|

*brahmahatyādipāpāni duritāni ca yāni ca \|*  
*tariṣyaṃti narāḥ sarve datte yuṣmatkare dhane \|\| 139 \|\|*

139\. When cash gift (as Dāna) is placed in your hands all men will surmount the sins of Brāhmaṇa-slaughter and all other sins.

## \|\| 1.165.140 \|\|

*mahīyadhve tu jāpyena prāṇāyāmaistribhiḥ kṛtaiḥ \|*  
*brahmahatyāsamaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva naśyati \|\| 140 \|\|*

140\. Due to the Japa and the three Prāṇāyāmas performed, you will become honoured. Every sin on a par with that of Brāhmaṇa-slaughter perishes at that very moment.

## \|\| 1.165.141 \|\|

*daśabhirjanmajanitaṃ śatena tu purā kṛtam \|*  
*triyugaṃ tu sahasreṇa gāyatrī haṃti kilbiṣam \|\| 141 \|\|*

141\. Gāyatrī repeated ten times destroys the sins committed in the whole birth (life time). If it is repeated a hundred times all the previous, accumulated sins are dissipated and if it is repeated a thousand times the sins of the three Yugas are dispelled.

## \|\| 1.165.142 \|\|

*evaṃ jñātvā sadā pūjyā jāpye ca mama vai kṛte \|*  
*bhaviṣyadhvaṃ na sandeho nātra kāryā vicāraṇā \|\| 142 \|\|*

142\. After knowing this and performing the Japa you all will become worthy of adoration. There is no doubt about it. No hesitation need be entertained in this respect.

## \|\| 1.165.143 \|\|

*oṃkāreṇa trimātreṇa sārdhena ca viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*pūjyāḥ sarve na sandeho japtvā māṃ śirasā saha \|\| 143 \|\|*

143\. After performing my Japa along with the Śiras (head) (i.e. the final foot) and Oṃkāra of three and half Mātrās, all of you will become worthy of adoration. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 1.165.144 \|\|

*aṣṭākṣarasthitā cāhaṃ jagadvyāptaṃ mayā tvidam \|*  
*mātā'haṃ sarvavedānāṃ vedaiḥ sarvairalaṅkatā \|\| 144 \|\|*

144\. I am abiding in eight syllables. This universe is pervaded by me. I am the mother of all the Vedas. I am embellished by all the Vedas.

## \|\| 1.165.145 \|\|

*jatvā māṃ paramāṃ sirddhi paśyanti dvijasattamāḥ \|*  
*prādhānyaṃ mama jāpyena sarveṣāṃ vo bhaviṣyati \|\| 145 \|\|*

145\. By means of the Japa of mine, all excellent Brāhmaṇas meet with perfect achievement. Due to my Jāpya all of you will attain domination over all.

## \|\| 1.165.146 \|\|

*gāyatrīsāramātro'pi varaṃ vipraḥ suyantritaḥ \|*  
*nāyaṃtritaścaturvedaḥ sarvāśī sarvavikrayī \|\| 146 \|\|*

146\. A Brāhmaṇa may possess only the essence of Gāyatrī. Possessed of perfect control and restraint: he is superior to a master of four Vedas even if he be devoid of self-control indulging in eating anything and everything and selling everything indiscriminately.

## \|\| 1.165.147 \|\|

*yasmādbhavatāṃ sāvitryā śāpo datto sade tviha \|*  
*atra dattaṃ hutaṃ cāpi sarvamakṣayakārakam \|*  
*datto varo mayā tena yuṣmākaṃ dvijasattamāḥ \|\| 147 \|\|*

147\. Here in this assembly, O excellent Brāhmaṇas, Sāvitrī has cursed you all. Hence this boon has been granted to you all by me. If a devotee makes any gift here or performs the Homa rite, it shall be of everlasting benefit.

## \|\| 1.165.148 \|\|

*agnihotraparā viprāstrikālaṃ homadāyinaḥ \|*  
*svargaṃ te tu gamiṣyaṃti ekaviṃśatibhiḥ kulaiḥ \|\| 148 \|\|*

148\. The Brāhmaṇas engaged in Agnihotra and performance of Homa thrice a day will go to heaven along with twenty-one generations of the family.”

## \|\| 1.165.149 \|\|

*evaṃ śakre ca viṣṇau ca rudre vai pāvake tathā \|*  
*brahmaṇo brahmaṇānāṃ ca gāyatrī sā varaṃ dadau \|*  
*tasminkāle varaṃ dattvā brahmaṇaḥ pārśvagā'bhavat \|\| 149 \|\|*

149\. In this manner, Gāyatrī granted boons to Śakra, Viṣṇu, Rudra, Pāvaka, Brahmā and the Brāhmaṇas. After granting the boons, she remained by the side of Brahmā.

## \|\| 1.165.150 \|\|

*hariṇā tu samākhyātaṃ lakṣmyāḥ śāpasya kāraṇam \|*  
*yuvatīnāṃ ca sarvāsāṃ śāpastāsāṃ pṛthakpṛthak \|\| 150 \|\|*

150\. The fact that Lakṣmī as well as all the youthful ladies were severally cursed, was mentioned by Hari (Viṣṇu).

## \|\| 1.165.151 \|\|

*lakṣmyāstadā varaṃ prādādgāyatrī brahmaṇaḥ priyā \|\| 151 \|\|*

151\. Then Gāyatrī, the beloved of Brahmā, granted a boon to Lakṣmī.

## \|\| 1.165.152 \|\|

*akutsitāḥ sadā putri tava vāsena śobhane \|*  
*bhaviṣyati na saṃdehaḥ sarvebhyaḥ prītidāyakāḥ \|\| 152 \|\|*

152\. “O my splendid lady, O my daughter, due to your stay, men will be able to delight all. No one will despise them. There is no doubt about this.

## \|\| 1.165.153 \|\|

*ye tvayā vīkṣitāḥ sarve sarve vai puṇyabhājanāḥ \|*  
*teṣāṃ jātiḥ kulaṃ śīlaṃ dharmaścaiva varānane \|\| 153 \|\|*

153\. O lady of excellent countenance, all those who are glanced at by you (favourably) shall be meritorious. Their caste, family, habit and virtue shall be of highest order.

## \|\| 1.165.154 \|\|

*parityaktāstvayā ye tu te narā duḥkhabhāginaḥ \|*  
*sabhāyāṃ te na śobhante manyante na ca pārthivaiḥ \|\| 154 \|\|*

154\. Men who are abandoned by you shall be miserable. They will never shine in an assembly. They will not be favourably considered by kings.

## \|\| 1.165.155 \|\|

*āśiṣaścaiva teṣāṃ tu kurvate vai dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*saujanyaṃ teṣu kurvanti naptā bhrātā pitā guruḥ \|\| 155 \|\|*

155\. Excellent Brāhmaṇas will shower blessings on them. Great-grandsons, brother, father and preceptor will give them gentleman-like treatment.

## \|\| 1.165.156-157 \|\|

*bāṃdhavo'si na saṃdeho na jīve'haṃ tvayā vinā \|*  
*tvayi dṛṣṭe prasannā me dṛṣṭirbhavati śobhanā \|*  
*manaḥ prasīdate'tyarthaṃ satyaṃsatyaṃ vadāmi te \|\| 156 \|\|*

*evaṃvidhāni vākyāni tvayā dṛṣṭyā nirīkṣite \|*  
*sajjanāste vadiṣyanti janānāṃ prītidāyakāḥ \|\| 157 \|\|*

156-157. ‘You are my kinsman. I cannot live without you. When you are seen my eyes become delighted and splendid. The mind is highly pleased. It is the truth. I speak the truth to you.’ These and similar words good men will speak to that person glanced at by you. They will delight persons.

## \|\| 1.165.158-160 \|\|

*indrāṇi nahuṣaḥ prāpya svargaṃ tvāṃ yācayiṣyati \|*  
*adṛṣṭvā tu hataḥ pāpo agastyavacanāddrutam \|\| 158 \|\|*

*sarpatvaṃ samanuprāpya prārthayiṣyati taṃ munim \|*  
*darpeṇāhaṃ vinaṣṭo'smi śaraṇaṃ me mune bhava \|\| 159 \|\|*

*vākyena tena tasyāsau nṛpasya bhagavānṛṣiḥ \|*  
*kṛtvā manasi kāruṇyamidaṃ vacanamabravīt \|\| 160 \|\|*

158-160. O Indrāṇī, after coming to Svarga, Nahuṣa will solicit. Unable to see you, the sinner will get struck by the curse of Agastya. He will be immediately turned into a serpent and will request the sage thus. ‘O sage, I am doomed due to my arrogance. Be my refuge.’ At these words of the king, the sage will become merciful and speak these words.

## \|\| 1.165.161 \|\|

*utpatsyati kule rājā tvadīye kurunaṃdana \|*  
*sārpaṃ kalevaraṃ dṛṣṭvā praśnaistvāmuddhariṣyati \|\| 161 \|\|*

161\. ‘O scion of the family of Kuru, a king will be born in your family. On seeing your serpentine body he will put some questions to you and redeem you.’

## \|\| 1.165.162 \|\|

*so'pyajagaratāṃ tyaktvā punaḥ svargaṃ gamiṣyati \|*  
*aśvamedhe kṛte bhartrā saha yāsi punardivi \|*  
*prāpsyase vara dānena mamānena sulocane \|\| 162 \|\|*

162\. Accordingly he (Nahuṣa) will abandon the state of python and will go back to heaven. When a horse-sacrifice is performed, you will once again go to heaven along with your husband. O lady of excellent eyes, you will attain everything through this boon of mine.”

## \|\| 1.165.163 \|\|

*devapatnyastadā sarvāstuṣṭayā paribhāṣitāḥ \|*  
*apatyairapi hīnāḥ syurnaiva duḥkhaṃ bhaviṣyati \|\| 163 \|\|*

163\. Thereafter, all the wives of Devas were addressed by the delighted one (i.e. Gāyatrī): “You may be devoid of children but will never be miserable.”

## \|\| 1.165.164 \|\|

*iti dattvā varāndevī gāyatrī lokasaṃmatā \|*  
*jagāmādarśanaṃ devī sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ tadā \|\| 164 \|\|*

164\. After granting boons thus, Gāyatrī honoured by the world vanished even as all those were watching.

## \|\| 1.165.165 \|\|

*sāvitrī tu tadā devī prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāgatā \|*  
*kṛtasmarasya śṛṅge tu śrīsomeśvarapūrvataḥ \|\| 165 \|\|*

165\. Then Sāvitrī, the divine lady, came to the holy spot of Prabhāsa on the peak of Kṛtasmara to the east of Śrīsomeśvara.

## \|\| 1.165.166 \|\|

*manvantare cākṣuṣe ca dvitīye dvāpare śubhe \|*  
*tatra yajñaḥ samārabdho brahmaṇā lokakāriṇā \|\| 166 \|\|*

166\. In the second splendid Dvāpara in the Cāksuṣa Manvantara, a Yajña was begun there by Brahmā, the creator of the worlds.

## \|\| 1.165.167 \|\|

*yajñe yātā mahātmāno devāḥ saptarṣayo varāḥ \|*  
*svāyaṃbhuve tu ye śastāḥ śaptāste cābhavanpurā \|\| 167 \|\|*

167\. The noble-souled Devas and the excellent seven sages attended that Yajña. Those who had been earlier cursed in the Svāyaṃbhuva Manvantara became esteemed then.

## \|\| 1.165.168 \|\|

*tasmātkālātsamārabhya prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāśritāḥ \|\| 168 \|\|*

168\. Ever since then, they resorted to the holy spot of Prabhāsa.

## \|\| 1.165.169 \|\|

*sāvitrī lokajananī lokānugrahakāriṇī \|*  
*yastāṃ pūjayate bhaktyā pakṣamekaṃ niraṃtaram \|*  
*brahmapūjāvidhānena tasya putro dhruvo bhavet \|\| 169 \|\|*

169\. Sāvitrī is the mother of the worlds. She blesses the worlds. If anyone devoutly adores her in accordance with the injunctions of the worship of Brahmā, he will certainly have a son.

## \|\| 1.165.170-172 \|\|

*pāṇḍukūpe naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā liṃgāni pañca vai \|*  
*pāṇḍavaiḥ sthāpitānīha dṛṣṭvā yajñaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 170 \|\|*

*jyeṣṭhasya pūrṇimāyāṃ tu sāvitrīsthalasaṃnidhau \|*  
*paṭhedyo brahmasūktāni mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ \|\| 171 \|\|*

*etatte sarvavikhyātamākhyātaṃ kalmaṣāpaham \|*  
*yaścedaṃ śṛṇuyādbhaktyā sa gacchetparamaṃ padam \|\| 172 \|\|*

170-172. A man who takes his holy bath in Pāṇḍukūpa and views the five Liṅgas installed by Pāṇḍavas will attain the benefit of a Yajña.

One who recites Brahmasūktas in the vicinity of the Sāvitrī Sthala on the Full-Moon day of the month of Jyeṣṭha, shall be rid of all sins. Thus the famous story of Sāvitrī has been narrated to you. It is destructive of sins. One who devoutly listens to this shall attain the greatest region.

## Chapter 166 - The Details of Sāvitrī Pūjā

## \|\| 1.166.1-2 \|\|

*devyuvāca \|*  
*prabhāse saṃsthitā yā tu sāvitrī brahmaṇaḥ priyā \|*  
*tasyāścaritraṃ me brūhi devadeva jagatpate \|\| 1 \|\|*

*vratamāhātmyasaṃyuktamitihāsasamanvitam \|*  
*pāti vratyakaraṃ strīṇāṃ mahābhāgyaṃ mahodayam \|\| 2 \|\|*

Devī said:

1-2. O Lord of Devas, O Lord of the universe, tell me the story of Sāvitri, the beloved of Brahmā, who stayed at Prabhāsa.

It should include therein the whole traditional account and the greatness of Vratas. It will contribute to the establishment of fidelity in women (to their husbands). It is conducive to great rise and good luck.

## \|\| 1.166.3 \|\|

*īśvara uvāca \|*  
*kathayāmi mahādevi sāvitryāścaritaṃ mahat \|*  
*prabhāsakṣetrasaṃsthāyāḥ sthala sthāne maheśvari \|*  
*yathā cīrṇaṃ vratakaraṃ sāvitryā rājakanyayā \|\| 3 \|\|*

Īśvara said:

3\. O great goddess, I shall narrate to you the great story of Sāvitrī who stationed herself in the holy spot of Prabhāsa in the sacred region. I shall also recount the excellent Vrata performed by Princess Sāvitrī.

## \|\| 1.166.4 \|\|

*āsīnmadreṣu dharmātmā sarvabhūtahite rataḥ \|*  
*pārthivo'śvapatirnāma paurajānapada priyaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. There was a righteous king named as Aśvapati in the land of Madra. He was engaged in activities bringing about the welfare of all living beings. He was a favourite with the inhabitants of towns as well as those of rural area.

## \|\| 1.166.5 \|\|

*kṣamāvānanapatyaśca satyavādī jitendriyaḥ \|*  
*prabhāsakṣetrayātrāyāmājagāma sa bhūpatiḥ \|*  
*yātrāṃ kurvanvidhānena sāvitrīsthalamāgataḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. He was truthful in speech. He controlled his sense-organs. He was a man of patience and forbearance. Unfortunately he had no issue. That king undertook a pilgrimage to the holy place of Prabhāsa. In the course of his pilgrimage, he came to the sacred spot of Sāvitrī.

## \|\| 1.166.6 \|\|

*sa sabhāryo vratamidaṃ tatra cakre nṛpaḥ svayam \|*  
*sāvitrīti prasiddhaṃ yatsarvakāmaphalapradam \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. In the company of his wife, the king himself took up the holy Vrata well-known as Sāvitrī Vrata. It bestows all desired benefits.

## \|\| 1.166.7 \|\|

*tasya tuṣṭā'bhavaddevi sāvitrī brahmaṇaḥ priyā \|*  
*bhūrbhuvaḥsvaritītyeṣā sākṣānmūrtimatī sthitā \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Goddess Sāvitrī, the beloved of Brahmā, the personified form of the Mantras Bhūḥ, Bhuvaḥ and Svaḥ, became pleased with him and appeared before him in person.

## \|\| 1.166.8 \|\|

*kamaṃḍaludharā devī jagāmādarśanaṃ punaḥ \|*  
*kālena vahunā jātā duhitā devarūpiṇī \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. The Goddess holding Kamaṇḍalu (water-pot) vanished from the scene. After a long time she incarnated as his daughter with divine form and features.

## \|\| 1.166.9 \|\|

*sāvitryā prītayā dattā sāvitryāḥ pūjayā tathā \|*  
*sāvitrītyeva nāmā'syāścakre viprājñayā nṛpaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Indeed, she had been given to him by Goddess Sāvitrī who was pleased due to the worship of Sāvitrī. At the behest of Brāhmaṇas, the king named his daughter Sāvitrī.

## \|\| 1.166.10 \|\|

*sā vigrāhavatīva śrīḥ prāvardhata nṛpātmajā \|*  
*sāvitrī sukumārāṃgī yauvanasthā babhūva ha \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. That princess grew up like the goddess of fortune in an embodied form. Sāvitrī of tender limbs reached the stage of youth.

## \|\| 1.166.11 \|\|

*yā sumadhyā pṛthuśroṇī pratimā kāñcanī yathā \|*  
*prāpteyaṃ devakanyā vā dṛṣṭvā tāṃ menire janāḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. With excellent waist and large buttocks she resembled a golden statue. On seeing her, the people thought, ‘Oh! Has a divine girl come over here?’

## \|\| 1.166.12 \|\|

*sā tu padmā viśālākṣī prajvalatīva tejasā \|*  
*cacāra sā ca sāvitrī vrataṃ yadbhṛguṇoditam \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. The girl with large eyes resembling lotus-petals and shining with her splendour performed Sāvitrī Vrata as expounded by Bhṛgu.

## \|\| 1.166.13 \|\|

*athopoṣya śiraḥsnātā devatāmabhigamya ca \|*  
*hutvāgniṃ vidhivadviprānvācayedvaravarṇinī \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. She duly observed fast, had head-bath and then she approached the deity. The girl of excellent complexion performed Homa in fire duly. She made the Brāhmaṇas utter sacred Mantras for the propitiation (of Sāvitrī).

## \|\| 1.166.14 \|\|

*tebhyaḥ sumanasaḥ śeṣāṃ pratigṛhya nṛpātmajā \|*  
*sakhīparivṛtā'bhyetya devī śrīvatsarūpiṇī \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. The fair princess, beautiful in form like Goddess Śrī, received Śeṣa (remnants of floral offerings to the deity) from them.

## \|\| 1.166.15 \|\|

*sā'bhivādya pituḥ pādau śeṣāṃ pūrvaṃ nivedya ca \|*  
*kṛtāñjalirvarārohā nṛpateḥ pārśvataḥ sthitā \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. After touching the feet of her father in paying respects to him, she proffered the Śeṣa to him and stood by the side of the king with palms joined in reverence.

## \|\| 1.166.16 \|\|

*tāṃ dṛṣṭvā yauvanaprāptāṃ svāṃ sutāṃ devarūpiṇīm \|*  
*uvāca rājā saṃmantrya putryarthaṃ saha mantribhiḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Noticing that his daughter of divine form and features had reached the. youthful stage, he consulted his ministers about a bridegroom for his daughter and said:

## \|\| 1.166.17-20 \|\|

*putri pradānakālaste na hi kaścidvṛṇoti mām \|*  
*vicārayanna paśyāmi varaṃ tulyamihātmanaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*devādīnāṃ yathā vācyo na bhaveyaṃ tathā kuru \|*  
*paṭhyamānaṃ mayā putri dharmaśāstreṣu ca śrutam \|\| 18 \|\|*

*piturgehe tu yā kanyā rajaḥ paśyatyasaṃskṛtā \|*  
*brahmahatyā pitustasya sā kanyā vṛṣalī smṛtā \|\| 19 \|\|*

*ato'rthaṃ preṣayāmi tvāṃ kuru putri svayaṃvaram \|*  
*vṛddhairamātyaiḥ sahitā śīghraṃ gacchāvadhāraya \|\| 20 \|\|*

17-20. “My dear daughter, it is time that you are to be given away in marriage. But no youth has approached me with a request. Even after pondering over, I do not find any bridegroom befitting ourselves.

You are to behave in a manner that will give no cause to the Devas to despise me. My dear daughter, I have heard this cited in sacred scriptures.

‘If without being consecrated (in marriage) a girl discharges her menses in her father’s house the father earns the sin of Brāhmaṇa-slaying and the girl is known as a Vṛṣalī (Śūdrā).’

Therefore, I am sending you off in the company of aged ministers. Hurry up. Choose your own husband and decide.”

## \|\| 1.166.21 \|\|

*evamastviti sāvitrī procya tasmādviniryayau \|*  
*tapovanāni ramyāṇi rājarṣīṇāṃ jagāma sā \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Saying “So be it”, Sāvitrī set off from their abode and went to the beautiful penance groves of saintly kings.

## \|\| 1.166.22-23 \|\|

*mānyānāṃ tatra vṛddhānāṃ kṛtvā pādābhivandanam \|*  
*tato'bhigamya tīrthāni sarvāṇyevāśramāṇi ca \|\| 22 \|\|*

*ājagāma punarveśma sāvitrī saha maṃtribhiḥ \|*  
*tatrāpaśyata devarṣiṃ nāradaṃ purataḥ śucim \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. There she paid obeisance to the feet of elderly and venerable persons. After visiting all holy spots and hermitages, Sāvitrī returned home along with the ministers. There she saw the celestial sage Nārada, the pure one, in her front.

## \|\| 1.166.24 \|\|

*āsīnamāsane vipraṃ praṇamya smitabhāṣiṇī \|*  
*kathayāmāsa tatkāryaṃ yenāraṇyaṃ gatā ca sā \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. The Brāhmaṇa was seated on his seat. The smiling girl bowed down to him and told him why she had gone out into the forests.

## \|\| 1.166.25 \|\|

*sāvitryuvāca \|*  
*āsīcchālveṣu dharmātmā kṣatriyaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ \|*  
*dyumatsena iti khyāto daivādandho vabhūva saḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

Sāvitrī said:

25\. “In the Śālva territories there was a Kṣatriya king well-known as Dyumatsena. As ill luck would have it he had become blind.

## \|\| 1.166.26 \|\|

*āryasya bālaputrasya dyumatsenasya rukmiṇā \|*  
*sāmantena hṛtaṃ rājyaṃ chidre'sminpūrvavairiṇā \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Even as his son was yet a boy (due to his weak point) the noble Lord Dyumatsena’s kingdom was seized by a vassal king Rukmin who was his previous enemy.

## \|\| 1.166.27 \|\|

*sa bālavatsayā sārdhaṃ bhāryayā prasthito vanam \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Along with his wife and the darling son yet a boy, he entered the forest.

## \|\| 1.166.28 \|\|

*sa tasya ca vane vṛddhaḥ putraḥ paramadhārmikaḥ \|*  
*satyavāganurūpo me bharteti manasepsitaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. The boy grew up in the forest as an extremely virtuous man. His name is Satyavān. I have mentally desired him as my befitting husband.

## \|\| 1.166.29 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*aho bata mahatkaṣṭaṃ sāvitryā nṛpate kṛtam \|*  
*bālasvabhāvādanayā guṇavānsatyavāgvṛtaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

Nārada said:

29\. Alas, it is a great pity, O king! What has been committed by Sāvitrī is very pitiable. On account of her childishness, Satyavāg (Satyavān) though virtuous, has been selected.

## \|\| 1.166.30 \|\|

*satyaṃ vadatyasya pitā satyaṃ mātā prabhāṣate \|*  
*satyaṃ vadeti munibhiḥ satyavānnāma vai kṛtam \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. “His father tells the truth. It is the truth that his mother speaks. You too do speak the truth.” Saying thus the sages named him Satyavān.

## \|\| 1.166.31 \|\|

*nityaṃ cāśvāḥ priyāstasya karotyaśvāśca mṛnmayān \|*  
*citre'pi ca likhatyaśvāṃścitrāśva iti cocyate \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. He is always fond of horses. He makes horses out of clay. He draws the pictures of horses too. Hence he is called Citrāśva also.

## \|\| 1.166.32 \|\|

*satyavānraṃtidevasya śiṣyo dānaguṇaiḥ samaḥ \|*  
*brahmaṇyaḥ satyavādī ca śibirauśīnaro yathā \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Satyavān is a disciple of Rantideva and on a par with him in the qualities of liberal-mindedness. He is an adorer of Brāhmaṇas. He always speaks the truth like Śibi of Uśīnara.

## \|\| 1.166.33 \|\|

*yayātiriva codāraḥ somavatpriyadarśanaḥ \|*  
*rūpeṇānyatamo'śvibhyāṃ dyumatsenasuto balī \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. The powerful son of Dyumatsena is of exalted nature like Yayāti. Like the moon, he is pleasant to look at. In beauty he can be considered as one among the Aśvins.

## \|\| 1.166.34 \|\|

*eko doṣo'sti nānyaśca so'dyaprabhṛti satyavān \|*  
*saṃvatsareṇa kṣīṇāyurdehatyāgaṃ kariṣyati \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. He has only one defect. Nothing else. From now onwards within a year Satyavān will give up his body. The span of his life is very short.

## \|\| 1.166.35 \|\|

*nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā duhitā prāha pārthivam \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. On hearing Nārada’s words the daughter said to the king:

## \|\| 1.166.36 \|\|

*sāvitryuvāca \|*  
*sakṛjjalpaṃti rājānaḥ sakṛjjalpaṃti brāhmaṇāḥ \|*  
*sakṛtkanyā pradīyeta trīṇyetāni sakṛtsakṛt \|\| 36 \|\|*

Sāvitrī said:

36\. Kings utter only once. Brāhmaṇas speak only once. A virgin is given away only once. These three occur once only.

## \|\| 1.166.37 \|\|

*dīrghāyurathavālpāyuḥ saguṇo nirguṇo'pi vā \|*  
*sakṛdvṛto mayā bhartā na dvitīyaṃ vṛṇomyaham \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. He may be long-lived or one with a short span of life. He may possess good qualities or be devoid of them. My husband has been chosen by me once, I will not woo another one.

## \|\| 1.166.38 \|\|

*manasā niścayaṃ kṛtvā tato vācā'bhidhīyate \|*  
*kriyate karmaṇā paścātpramāṇaṃ hi manastataḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. One resolves mentally and then utters it verbally. Thereafter it is carried out in action. Therefore, it is the mind that is the authority.

## \|\| 1.166.39 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*yadyetadiṣṭaṃ bhavataḥ śīghrameva vidhīyatām \|*  
*avighnena tu sāvitryāḥ pradānaṃ duhitustava \|\| 39 \|\|*

Nārada said:

39\. If Your Highness approves this, let it be carried out quickly. Let the marriage of your daughter Sāvitrī be celebrated without any hindrance.

## \|\| 1.166.40 \|\|

*evamuktvā samutpatya nārūdastridivaṃ gataḥ \|*  
*rājā ca duhituḥ sarvaṃ vaivāhikamathākarot \|*  
*śubhe muhūrte pārśvasthairbrāhmaṇairvedapāragaiḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. After saying this Nārada flew up and went to heaven. The king celebrated the rites of the marriage of his daughter in an auspicious hour through Brāhmaṇas of the neighbourhood, who had mastered the Vedas.

## \|\| 1.166.41 \|\|

*sāvitryapi ca taṃ labdhvā bhartāraṃ manaseptitam \|\| \|*  
*mumude'tīva tanvaṃgī svargaṃ prāpyeva puṇyakṛt \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. On obtaining a husband mentally desired, the slender-limbed Sāvitrī rejoiced much like a man of meritorious actions on attaining heaven.

## \|\| 1.166.42 \|\|

*evaṃ tatrāśrame teṣāṃ tadā nivasatāṃ satām \|*  
*kālastu paśyatāṃ kiñcidaticakrāma pārvati \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Thus, O Pārvatī, even as those persons residing in the hermitage were watching a few days elapsed.

## \|\| 1.166.43 \|\|

*sāvitryāstu tadā nāryāstiṣṭhantyāśca divāniśam \|*  
*nāradena yaduktaṃ tadvākyaṃ manasi vartate \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. The words uttered by Nārada persisted in the mind of Sāvitrī day in and day out.

## \|\| 1.166.44 \|\|

*tataḥ kāle bahutithe vyatikrānte kadācana \|*  
*prāptaḥ kālo'tha martavyo yatra satyavrato nṛpaḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. Many days elapsed and finally that particular hour too arrived when Prince Satyavrata had to meet with death.

## \|\| 1.166.45-46 \|\|

*jyeṣṭhamāse site pakṣe dvādaśyāṃ rajanīmukhe \|*  
*gaṇayaṃtyāśca sāvitryā nāradoktaṃ vaco hṛdi \|\| 45 \|\|*

*caturthe'hani martavyamiti saṃciṃtya bhāminī \|*  
*vrataṃ trirātramuddiśya divārātraṃ sthitā'śrame \|\| 46 \|\|*

45-46. Even as Sāvitrī was pondering over the words of Nārada, at nightfall on the twelfth lunar day in the bright half of the month of Jyeṣṭha (the beautiful lady reflected this): ‘He is to meet with death on the fourth day.’ She observed Vrata lasting the next three days; she therefore continued to stay in the hermitage.

## \|\| 1.166.47 \|\|

*tatastrirātraṃ nyavasatsnātvā saṃtarpya devatām \|*  
*śvaśrūśvaśurayoḥ pādau vavaṃde cāruhāsinī \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. On those three days, she took regular baths and propitiated the deities. The beautifully smiling lady touched the feet of her mother-in-law and father-in-law and paid her respects.

## \|\| 1.166.48 \|\|

*atha pratasthe paraśuṃ gṛhītvā satyavānvanam \|*  
*sāvitryapi ca bhartāraṃ gacchaṃtaṃ pṛṣṭhato'nvayāt \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Thereafter, taking up his axe Satyavān started towards the forest. Sāvitrī followed her husband as he went ahead.

## \|\| 1.166.49 \|\|

*tato gṛhītvā tarasā phalapuṣpasamitkuśān \|*  
*atha śuṣkāṇi cādāya kāṣṭhabhāramakalpayat \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Satyavān hurriedly gathered fruits, flowers, sacrificial twigs and Darbha grass; collecting together some dry branches (as fuel) he bundled them together.

## \|\| 1.166.50 \|\|

*atha pāṭayataḥ kāṣṭhaṃ jātā śirasi vedanā \|*  
*kāṣṭhabhāraṃ kṣaṇāttyaktvā vaṭaśākhāvalaṃbitaḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. As he was cutting wood, he suffered from severe headache. Instantly he left the bundle of fuel wood and stood leaning against the branch of a Vaṭa tree.

## \|\| 1.166.51 \|\|

*sāvitrīṃ prāha śiraso vedanā māṃ prabādhate \|*  
*tavotsaṃge kṣaṇaṃ tāvatsvaptumicchāmi sundari \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. He told Sāvitrī “My charming beloved, a nasty headache torments me, I wish to sleep for a short while on your lap.”

## \|\| 1.166.52 \|\|

*viśramasva mahābāho sāvitrī prāha duḥkhitā \|*  
*paścādapi gamiṣyāmi hyāśramaṃ śramanāśanam \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. The grief-stricken Sāvitrī said: “O my darling of mighty arms, do take rest. We shall go to our hermitage later to dispel our fatigue fully.”

## \|\| 1.166.53 \|\|

*yāvadutsaṃgagaṃ kṛtvā śirosya tu mahītale \|*  
*tāvaddadarśa sāvitrī puruṣaṃ kṛṣṇapiṃgalam \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. Sāvitrī sat on the ground keeping his head on her lap, when she saw a dark, tawny-coloured being.

## \|\| 1.166.54 \|\|

*kirīṭinaṃ pītavastraṃ sākṣātsūryamivoditam \|*  
*tamuvācātha sāvitrī praṇamya madhurākṣaram \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. He was clad in yellow garments and had a crown on his head. He was brilliant like the rising sun. Sāvitrī bowed down to him and said sweetly:

## \|\| 1.166.55-56 \|\|

*kastvaṃ devo'thavā daityo yo māṃ dharṣitumāgataḥ \|*  
*na cāhaṃ kenacicchakyā svadharmāddeva rodhitum \|\| 55 \|\|*

*viddhi māṃ puruṣaśreṣṭha dīptāmagniśikhāmiva \|\| 56 \|\|*

55-56. “Who are you? A Deva or a Daitya come to assail and assault me? But beware, I cannot be swayed from doing my duty, O lord. O most excellent being, know me to be a blazing flame of fire.”

## \|\| 1.166.57 \|\|

*yama uvāca \|*  
*yamaḥ saṃyamanaścāsmi sarvalokabhayaṃkaraḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

Yama said:

57\. I am Yama, who controls and restrains, the terror of all the worlds.

## \|\| 1.166.58 \|\|

*kṣīṇāyureṣa te bhartā saṃnidhau te pativrate \|*  
*na śakyaḥ kiṃkarairnetumato'haṃ svayamāgataḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. This husband of yours has come to the end of the span of his life. Yet, O chaste lady, in your presence, he cannot be led away by my servants. Hence I have come personally.

## \|\| 1.166.59 \|\|

*evamuktvā satyavrataśarīrātpāśasaṃyutaḥ \|*  
*aṃguṣṭhamātraṃ puruṣaṃ nicakarṣa yamo balāt \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. After saying thus, Yama extracted forcibly the thumbsized inner soul from the body of Satyavrata (Satyavān) by means of his noose.

## \|\| 1.166.60 \|\|

*atha prayātumārebhe paṃthānaṃ pitṛsevitam \|*  
*sāvitryapi varārohā pṛṣṭhato'nujagāma ha \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. Then he began to proceed along the path resorted to by Pitṛs. The beautiful lady Sāvitrī too closely followed him.

## \|\| 1.166.61-62 \|\|

*pativratatvāccāśrāṃtā tāmuvāca yamastathā \|*  
*nivarta gaccha sāvitri muhūrtaṃ tvamihāgatā \|\| 61 \|\|*

*eṣa mārgo viśālākṣi na kenāpyanugamyate \|\| 62 \|\|*

61-62. Yama spoke to her who was never tired, thanks to the power of her fidelity to her husband. “O Sāvitrī, go back you have traversed here for a Muhūrta. O lady of large eyes, this pathway cannot be traversed by anyone.”

## \|\| 1.166.63 \|\|

*sāvitryuvāca \|*  
*na śramo na ca me glāniḥ kadācidapi jāyate \|*  
*bhartāramanugacchantyā viśiṣṭasya ca saṃnidhau \|\| 63 \|\|*

Sāvitrī said:

63\. I have no fatigue, I am not tired. Following my husband is never tiresome especially in the presence of an exalted person (like you).

## \|\| 1.166.64 \|\|

*satāṃ santo gatirnānyā strīṇāṃ bhartā sadā gatiḥ \|*  
*vedo varṇāśramāṇāṃ ca śiṣyāṇāṃ ca gatirguruḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. Good people are the only resort unto good people, none else. Husband is the permanent resort unto women. The Veda is the sole resort unto all the castes and stages of life and preceptor is the ultimate resort unto disciples.

## \|\| 1.166.65 \|\|

*sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ sthānamasti mahītale \|*  
*bharttāramekamutsṛjya strīṇāṃ nānyaḥ samāśrayaḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. There is a place of rest and refuge on the earth for all living beings. But excepting the husband alone, there is no place of resort unto women.

## \|\| 1.166.66 \|\|

*evamanyaiḥ sumadhurairvākyairdharmārthasaṃhitaiḥ \|*  
*tutoṣa sūryatanayaḥ sāvitrīṃ vākyamabravīt \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. The son of the Sun-god (Yama) was pleased with these and such other equally sweet words couched in righteousness. He spoke to Sāvitrī:

## \|\| 1.166.67-70 \|\|

*yama uvāca \|*  
*tuṣṭo'smi tava bhadraṃ te varaṃ varaya bhāmini \|*  
*sāpi vavre ca rājyaṃ svaṃ vinayāvanatānanā \|\| 67 \|\|*

*cakṣuḥprāptiṃ tathā rājyaṃ śvaśurasya mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*pituḥ putraśataṃ caiva putrāṇāṃ śatamātmanaḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

*jīvitaṃ ca tathā bharturdharmasiddhiṃ ca śāśvatīm \|*  
*dharmarājo varaṃ dattvā preṣayāmāsa tāṃ tataḥ \|\| 69 \|\|*

*atha bhartāramāsādya sāvitrī hṛṣṭamānasā \|*  
*jagāma svāśramapadaṃ saha bhartrā nirākulā \|\| 70 \|\|*

Yama said:

67a. O beautiful woman, I am pleased with you. Welfare unto you. Choose your boon.

67b-70. With her head bent down out of modesty, she asked for her own kingdom. She prayed that her noble-souled father-in-law should get back his eyesight and the lost kingdom. She requested for a hundred sons to her father and another hundred for herself. (As a result thereof) She wanted the life of her husband as well as attainment of Dharma (righteousness) for ever. Dharmarāja granted her all the boons and sent her back.

Having got back her husband, Sāvitrī was highly delighted in her mind. Freed from all worries she went back to the hermitage along with her husband.

## \|\| 1.166.71 \|\|

*jyeṣṭhasya pūrṇimāyāṃ ca tayā cīrṇaṃ vrataṃ tvidam \|*  
*māhātmyato'sya nṛpateścakṣuḥprāptirabhūtpuraḥ \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. It was on the Full-Moon day in the month of Jyeṣṭha that she observed this Vrata. Due to its efficacy, the king regained his eyesight.

## \|\| 1.166.72 \|\|

*tataḥ svadeśarājyaṃ ca prāpa niṣkaṇṭakaṃ nṛpaḥ \|*  
*pitāsyāḥ putraśatakaṃ sā ca lebhe sutāñchatam \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. Then the king regained his dominion free from thorns. Her father begot a hundred sons. She too gave birth to a hundred sons.

## \|\| 1.166.73 \|\|

*evaṃ vratasya māhātmyaṃ kathitaṃ sakalaṃ mayā \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. Thus the importance and the efficacy of the Vrata in full has been narrated by me.

## \|\| 1.166.74 \|\|

*devyuvāca \|*  
*kīdṛśaṃ tadvrataṃ deva sāvitryā caritaṃ mahat \|*  
*tasmiṃstu jyeṣṭhamāse hi vidhānaṃ tasya kīdṛśam \|\| 74 \|\|*

The Devī said:

74\. Of what nature is that great Vrata, which was performed by Sāvitri, O Lord? What is the procedure of that Vrata in the month of Jyeṣṭha?

## \|\| 1.166.75 \|\|

*kā devatā vrate tasminke mantrāḥ kiṃ phalaṃ vibho \|*  
*vistareṇa maheśa tvaṃ brūhi dharmaṃ sanātanam \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. Who is the deity in that Vrata? What are the Mantras? O Lord, what is the benefit? O Maheśa, do describe this eternal sacred rite in detail.

## \|\| 1.166.76 \|\|

*īśvara uvāca \|*  
*śrūyatāṃ devadeveśi sāvitrīvratamā darāt \|*  
*kathayāmi yathā cīrṇaṃ tayā satyā maheśvari \|\| 76 \|\|*

Īśvara said:

76\. O goddess of the chiefs of Devas, may the Sāvitrī Vrata be listened to with great respect. O Maheśvarī, I shall describe the manner in which it was performed by that chaste lady.

## \|\| 1.166.77 \|\|

*trayodaśyāṃ tu jyeṣṭhasya dantadhāvanapūrvakam \|*  
*trirātraṃ niyamaṃ kuryādupavāsasya bhāmini \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. Starting with the cleaning of the teeth on the thirteenth lunar day in the month of Jyeṣṭha, O fair lady, a devotee should observe the restraints and have fast for three nights.

## \|\| 1.166.78 \|\|

*aśaktastu trayodaśyāṃ naktaṃ kuryājjitendriyaḥ \|*  
*ayācitaṃ caturdaśyāṃ hyupavāsena pūrṇimām \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. If one is too weak one should take meal at night but must observe control of the sense-organs. On the fourteenth day, food received without request (Ayācita) may be taken but there shall be complete fast.

## \|\| 1.166.79 \|\|

*nityaṃ snātvā taḍāge vā mahānadyāṃ ca nirjhare \|*  
*pāṃḍukūpe tu suśroṇi sarvasnānaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. By taking the holy bath everyday in a lake, a great river, a stream or in Pāṇḍukūpa, O lady of excellent buttocks, the devotee shall attain the benefit of all baths.

## \|\| 1.166.80 \|\|

*viśeṣātpūrṇimāyāṃ tu snānaṃ sarṣapamṛjjalaiḥ \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. Especially on the Full-Moon day the bath should be with mustard, clay and water.

## \|\| 1.166.81 \|\|

*gṛhītvā vālukaṃ pātre prasthamātre yaśasvini \|*  
*athavā dhānyamādāya yavaśālitilādikam \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. O renowned lady, the devotee should take sand in a vessel of the capacity of a Prastha or it may be any grain such as barley, paddy, gingelly seeds etc.

## \|\| 1.166.82 \|\|

*tato vaṃśamaye pātre vastrayugmena veṣṭite \|*  
*sāvitrīpratimāṃ kṛtvā sarvāvayavaśobhitām \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. In a vessel made of bamboo covered with two cloths, the devotee should place an idol of Sāvitri, lustrous, beautiful in every limb.

## \|\| 1.166.83 \|\|

*sauvarṇīṃ mṛnmayīṃ vāpi svaśaktyā dārunirmitām \|*  
*raktavastradvayaṃ dadyātsāvitryā brahmaṇaḥ sitam \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. The devotee should make the idol of clay, wood or gold in accordance with his capacity. A pair of red cloths is to be offered to Sāvitrī and a single white cloth to Brahmā.

## \|\| 1.166.84-87 \|\|

*sāvitrīṃ brahmaṇā sārdhamevaṃ śaktyā prapūjayet \|*  
*gandhaiḥ sugandhapuṣpaiśca dhūpanaivedyadīpakaiḥ \|\| 84 \|\|*

*pūrṇakośātakaiḥ pakvaiḥ kūṣmāṇḍakarkaṭīphalaiḥ \|*  
*nālikeraiḥ sakharjūraiḥ kapitthairdāḍimaiḥ śubhaiḥ \|\| 85 \|\|*

*jaṃbūjaṃbīranāriṃgairakṣoṭaiḥ panasaistathā \|*  
*jīrakaiḥ kaṭukhaṇḍaiśca guḍena lavaṇena ca \|\| 86 \|\|*

*virūḍhaiḥ saptadhānyaiśca vaṃśapātraprakalpitaiḥ \|*  
*raṃjayetpaṭṭasūtraiśca śubhaiḥ kuṃkumakesaraiḥ \|\| 87 \|\|*

84-87. In this manner, the devotee should worship Sāvitrī along with Brahmā in accordance with his capacity by means of sweet scents, fragrant flowers, incense, food offerings, lamps, full Kośātakas, ripe Kūṣmāṇḍa and Karkaṭī fruits, cucumber, coconuts, date fruits, Kapitthas (wood apple), splendid Dāḍimas (pomegranates), Jaṃbūs, Jambīras, Nāraṅgas (citrons), Akṣoṭas (walnuts), Panasas (jack-fruits), Jīrakas, Kaṭukhaṇḍas, jaggery, salt, germinating seven grains etc. These should be kept in vessels of bamboo. It should be coloured with Kuṃkuma and Kesara or beautified by means of silk threads.

## \|\| 1.166.88 \|\|

*avatāraṃ karotyevaṃ sāvitrī brahmaṇaḥ priyā \|\| 88 \|\|*

88\. Thus Sāvitrī, the beloved of Brahmā, will incarnate.

## \|\| 1.166.89 \|\|

*tāmarccayīta mantreṇa sāvitryā brahmaṇā samam \|*  
*itareṣāṃ purāṇokto maṃtro'yaṃ samudāhṛtaḥ \|\| 89 \|\|*

89\. The devotee should worship her along with Brahmā by means of Sāvitrī Mantra. Among others, the Mantra mentioned in the Purāṇas is recommended:

## \|\| 1.166.90 \|\|

*oṃkārapūrvake devi vīṇāpustakadhāriṇi \|*  
*vedāṃbike namastubhyamavaidhavyaṃ prayaccha me \|\| 90 \|\|*

90\. “Obeisance to you, O goddess, having Oṃkāra in the beginning, O goddess holding a lute and a book. O mother of Devas, grant me exemption from widowhood.”

## \|\| 1.166.91 \|\|

*evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivajjāgaraṃ tatra kārayet \|*  
*gītavāditraśabdenanaranārīkadaṃbakam \|*  
*nṛtyaddhasannayedrātriṃ nṛtyaśāstraviśāradaiḥ \|\| 91 \|\|*

91\. After worshipping duly thus, the devotee should arrange for Jāgara (a night vigil) when groups of men and women should sing and play on instruments, dance and laugh throughout the night in the company of experts in the science and art of dance.

## \|\| 1.166.92 \|\|

*sāvitryākhyānakaṃ cāpi vācayīta dvijottamān \|*  
*yāvatprabhātasamayaṃ gītabhāvarasaiḥ saha \|\| 92 \|\|*

92\. Till the day dawns, the Brāhmaṇas should be requested to relate the story of Sāvitrī making it interesting with songs of good sentiments.

## \|\| 1.166.93-94 \|\|

*vivāhamevaṃ kṛtvā tu sāvitryā brahmaṇā saha \|*  
*paridhāpya sitairvastrairdaṃpatīnāṃ tu saptakam \|\| 93 \|\|*

*gṛhadānaṃ pradātavyaṃ sarvopaskarasaṃyutam \|*  
*brāhmaṇe vedaviduṣe sāvitrīṃ vinivedayet \|\| 94 \|\|*

93-94. Thus the ceremony of the marriage of Sāvitrī with Brahmā should be performed. Seven couples should be offered white garments. Houses equipped with all requisite articles of furniture etc. should be gifted. The image of Sāvitrī should be given to a Brāhmaṇa well-versed in the Vedas.

## \|\| 1.166.95 \|\|

*atha sāvitrīkalpajñe sāvitryākhyānavācake \|*  
*daivajñe hyuñchavṛttisthe daridre cāgnihotriṇi \|\| 95 \|\|*

95\. Or the presents may be offered to one well-versed in Sāvitrīkalpa or one who narrates the story of Sāvitrī or to a Daivajña (astrologer) adhering to Uñcchavṛtti (maintenance by gleanings of rice-grains) or an Agnihotrin who is very poor.

## \|\| 1.166.96 \|\|

*evaṃ dattvā vidhānena tasyāṃ rātrau nimantrayet \|*  
*paurṇamāsyāṃ vaṭādhastāddaṃpatīnāṃ caturdaśa \|\| 96 \|\|*

96\. After making the offerings thus duly, the devotee should invite fourteen couples to a place beneath a Vaṭa (a Bunyan tree) during the night of Full-Moon.

## \|\| 1.166.97 \|\|

*tataḥ prabhātasamaye uṣaḥkāla upasthite \|*  
*bhakṣyabhojyādikaṃ sarvaṃ sāvitrīsthalamānayet \|\| 97 \|\|*

97\. When the day dawns and the morning arrives, all articles of food should be brought to the Sāvitrī Sthala (the spot where the rite is performed).

## \|\| 1.166.98 \|\|

*pākaṃ kṛtvā tu śucinā rakṣāṃ kṛtvā prayatnataḥ \|*  
*brāhmaṇāngṛhiṇīyuktāṃstata āhvānayetsudhīḥ \|\| 98 \|\|*

98\. After the cooking is concluded in strict hygienic conditions, and with due safeguards for purity, the wise devotees should invite Brāhmaṇas accompanied by their wives.

## \|\| 1.166.99 \|\|

*sāvitryāḥ sthalake tatra kṛtvā pādābhiṣecanam \|*  
*susnātānbrāhmaṇāṃstatra sabhāryānupaveśayet \|\| 99 \|\|*

99\. At the Sāvitrī Sthala itself the feet of the Brāhmaṇas should be washed. The devotee then makes the Brāhmaṇas and their wives who have taken their bath take their seats.

## \|\| 1.166.100 \|\|

*sāvitryāḥ purato devi daṃpatyorbhojanaṃ dadet \|*  
*tenāhaṃ bhojitastatra bhavāmīha na saṃśaya \|\| 100 \|\|*

100\. O goddess, food should be served to the couple sitting in front of Sāvitrī. Thereby it shall be deemed undoubtedly that I have been fed.

## \|\| 1.166.101 \|\|

*dvitīyaṃ bhojayedyastu bhojitastena keśavaḥ \|*  
*lakṣmyāḥ sahāyo varado varāṃstasya prayacchati \|\| 101 \|\|*

101\. If the devotee feeds a second Brāhmaṇa couple, Keśava will be deemed to have been fed thereby. The consort of Lakṣmī, the bestower of boons will grant him boons.

## \|\| 1.166.102 \|\|

*sāvitryā sahito brahmā tṛtīye bhojito bhavet \|*  
*ekaikaṃ bhojanaṃ tatra koṭibhojasamaṃ smṛtam \|\| 102 \|\|*

102\. If a third (Brāhmaṇa couple) is fed, it is as good as Brahmā accompanied by Sāvitrī has been fed. Each one of the meals there is remembered as akin to a crore of meals.

## \|\| 1.166.103 \|\|

*aṣṭādaśaprakāreṇa ṣaḍrasīkṛtabhojanam \|*  
*devyāstatra mahādevi sāvitrīsthalasannidhau \|\| 103 \|\|*

103\. O great goddess, in the vicinity of the Sāvitrī Sthala, it is actually an offering to the deity of food in the form of eighteen different dishes having all the six tastes.

## \|\| 1.166.104 \|\|

*vidhavā na kule tasya na vaṃdhyā na ca durbhagā \|*  
*na kanyājananī cāpi na ca syādbharturapriyā \|*  
*aṣṭau doṣāstu nārīṇāṃ na bhavaṃti kadācana \|\| 104 \|\|*

104\. There shall never be a widow in that family, nor a barren woman nor an unlucky wretched one. There shall never be a woman giving birth solely to baby-girls nor one incurring the displeasure of her husband. The eight defects that usually torment women will never affect them.

## \|\| 1.166.105 \|\|

*tasmātsarvaprayatnena sāvitryagre ca bhojanam \|*  
*dātavyaṃ sarvadā devi kaṭunīlavivarjitam \|\| 105 \|\|*

105\. Hence by all means, foodstuffs avoiding pungent and stale things, should be offered in front of Sāvitrī.

## \|\| 1.166.106 \|\|

*na cāmlaṃ na ca vai kṣāraṃ strīṇāṃ bhojyaṃ kadācana \|*  
*paṃcaprakāraṃ madhuraṃ hṛdyaṃ sarvaṃ susaṃskṛtam \|\| 106 \|\|*

106\. Food offered to women should never be sour or saltish. Five kinds of sweet dishes should be well-cooked, seasoned and served heartily.

## \|\| 1.166.107 \|\|

*ghṛtapūrṇāpūpakāśca bahukṣīrasamanvitāḥ \|*  
*pūpakāstādṛśāḥ kāryā dvitīyā'śokavartikā \|\| 107 \|\|*

107\. There should be pies full of ghee. There should be plenty of milk. Pūpakas should be made in that manner. A second sweet dish is Asokavanikā (Pheṇikā).

## \|\| 1.166.108 \|\|

*tṛtīyā pūpikā kāryā kharjureṇa samanvitāḥ \|*  
*caturthaścaiva saṃyāvo guḍājyābhyāṃ samanvitaḥ \|\| 108 \|\|*

108\. The third Pūpikā should be with Kharjūra (date-fruit). The fourth shall be Saṃyāva (Halva) soaked in ghee and jaggery.

## \|\| 1.166.109 \|\|

*āhlādakāriṇī puṃsāṃ strīṇāṃ cātīva vallabhā \|*  
*dhanadhānyajanopetaṃ nārīnaraśatākulam \|*  
*pūpakaistu kulaṃ tasyā jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 109 \|\|*

109\. This sweet dish of Pūpikā delights men, and women are very fond of it. Through Pūpikās that family shall be full of wealth and food-grain and with hundreds of men and women.

## \|\| 1.166.110 \|\|

*na jvaro na ca saṃtāpo duḥkhaṃ ca na viyogajam \|*  
*aśokavartidānena kulānāmekaviṃśatiḥ \|\| 110 \|\|*

110\. If the Āśokavarti (Pheṇikā) is served, twenty-one generations of the family flourish. There shall never occur fever or distress nor misery due to separation.

## \|\| 1.166.111 \|\|

*vadhūbhiśca sutaiścaiva dāsīdāsairanantakaiḥ \|*  
*pūritaṃ ca kulaṃ tasyāḥ pūrikā yā prayacchati \|\| 111 \|\|*

111\. If the devotee offers Pūrikās his family shall be filled with brides, sons, servants and servant-maids.

## \|\| 1.166.112 \|\|

*putriṇyo vai duhitaro vadhūbhiḥ sahitāḥ kule \|*  
*śikhariṇīpradātrīṇāṃ yuvatīnāṃ na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 112 \|\|*

112\. If young women offer Śikhariṇī (curds with sugar), there shall undoubtedly be sons and daughter-in-laws to the daughters in the family.

## \|\| 1.166.113 \|\|

*modate ca kulaṃ sarvaṃ sarvasiddhiprapūritam \|*  
*modakānāṃ pradānena evamāha pitāmahaḥ \|\| 113 \|\|*

113\. By offering Modakas (sweetmeat) as in charity the whole family shall rejoice filled with all perfect attainments—so says Pitāmaha.

## \|\| 1.166.114 \|\|

*etacca gauriṇīnāṃ tu bhojanaṃ hi viśiṣyate \|\| 114 \|\|*

114\. This type of food served to Gauriṇīs (women with husband and sons) is splendid.

## \|\| 1.166.115 \|\|

*subhagā putriṇī sādhvī dhanaṛddhisamanvitā \|*  
*sahasrabhojinī devi bhavejjanmanijanmani \|\| 115 \|\|*

115\. O goddess, a woman who feeds a thousand shall be lucky, chaste, endowed with sons, wealth and prosperity in every birth.

## \|\| 1.166.116-117 \|\|

*pānāni caiva mukhyāni hṛdyāni madhurāṇi ca \|*  
*drākṣāpānaṃ tu ciṃcāyāḥ pānaṃ guḍasamanvitam \|\| 116 \|\|*

*sarasena tu toyena kṛtakhaṇḍena vai śubham \|*  
*suvāsinīnāṃ peyaṃ vai dātavyaṃ ca dvijanmanām \|\| 117 \|\|*

116-117. There are important good beverages, hearty and sweet, such as Drākṣāpāna (grape-juice), the juice of tamarind with jaggery. It is splendid with sugar candy and water added. Such drinks should be offered to Brāhmaṇa Suvāsinīs (Gauriṇīs).

## \|\| 1.166.118 \|\|

*itarairitarāṇyeva varṇayogyāni yāni ca \|*  
*surabhīṇi ca pānāni tāsu yogyāni dāpayet \|\| 118 \|\|*

118\. Fragrant beverages of other kinds should be befittingly offered to the women of other castes.

## \|\| 1.166.119 \|\|

*pratipūjya vidhānena vastradānaiḥ sakaṃcukaiḥ \|*  
*kuṅkumenānuliptāṃgāḥ sragdāmabhiralaṃkṛtāḥ \|*  
*gaṃdhairdhūpaiśca saṃpūjya nālikerānpradāpayet \|\| 119 \|\|*

119\. The women should be adored duly with gifts of garments and bodices. They should be smeared with unguents of saffron. They should be embellished with garlands. After honouring them with scents and incense, they should be offered coconuts.

## \|\| 1.166.120 \|\|

*netrāṇāṃ cāñjanaṃ kṛtvā sindūraṃ caiva mastake \|*  
*pūgīphalāni hṛdyāni vāsitāni mṛdūni ca \|*  
*haste dattvā sapātrāṇi praṇipatya visarjayet \|\| 120 \|\|*

120\. Collyrium should be given for their eyes; Sindūra for the parting of hair on the head. Tasty arecanuts soft and sweetsmelling, should be given in their hands along with the vessels thereof. They should then be bowed down to and sent off.

## \|\| 1.166.121 \|\|

*svayaṃ ca bhojayetpaścādbaṃdhubhirbālakaiḥ saha \|\| 121 \|\|*

121\. The devotee then takes food along with the children and kinsmen.

## \|\| 1.166.122 \|\|

*athavā naiva saṃpadyettīrthe caiva tu bhojanam \|*  
*gṛhe gatvā prabhoktavyaṃ tuṣṭā devī yathā bhavet \|\| 122 \|\|*

122\. Or if meal could not be had at the Tīrtha, the devotee should take his meal after going home so that the goddess may be pleased.

## \|\| 1.166.123 \|\|

*evameva pitṝṇāṃ ca āgamya sve ca mandire \|*  
*piṇḍapradānapūrvaṃ tu śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ \|*  
*pitarastasya tuṣṭā vai bhavanti brahmaṇo dinam \|\| 123 \|\|*

123\. And, the devotee returns home and performs Śrāddha in accordance with the injunctions along with the offerings of rice-balls. His ancestors become contented for the period of a day of Brahmā (a thousand Yugas).

## \|\| 1.166.124 \|\|

*tīrthādaṣṭaguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ svagṛhe dadataḥ śubhe \|*  
*na ca paśyanti vai nīcāḥ śrāddhaṃ dattaṃ dvijātibhiḥ \|\| 124 \|\|*

124\. O splendid lady, the merit of one who offers Śrāddha in his own house is eight times more than that of one who offers it in the Tīrtha. Base people in that case will not cast their eyes on the Śrāddha offered by the twice-born.

## \|\| 1.166.125 \|\|

*ekānte tu gṛhe gupte pitṝṇāṃ śrāddhamiṣyate \|*  
*nīcaṃ dṛṣṭvā hataṃ tattu pitṝṇāṃ nopatiṣṭhati \|\| 125 \|\|*

125\. Hence it is advised that the Śrāddha of the Pitṛs should be performed in the isolated place of one’s own abode. (If done outside it on being seen by the base persons) the Śrāddha is spoiled (as it) does not reach the Pitṛs.

## \|\| 1.166.126 \|\|

*tasmātsarvaprayatnena śrāddhaṃ guptaṃ ca kārayet \|*  
*pitṝṇāṃ tṛptidaṃ proktaṃ svayameva svayaṃbhuvā \|\| 126 \|\|*

126\. Hence with all effort, one should offer Śrāddha in secret. It is said by the Self-born Lord himself that it is pleasing to the Pitṛs.

## \|\| 1.166.127 \|\|

*gaurībhojyādikā yā tu utsargātkriyate kriyā \|*  
*rājasī sā samākhyātā janānāṃ kīrtidāyinī \|\| 127 \|\|*

127\. The rite of feeding Gaurī etc., which is performed as a general rule is termed Rājasī (based on Rajas Guṇa). It bestows renown on people.

## \|\| 1.166.128 \|\|

*idaṃ dānaṃ sadā deyamātmano hita micchatā \|*  
*śrāddhe caiva viśeṣeṇa yadīcchetsāttvikaṃ phalam \|\| 128 \|\|*

128\. This Dāna should be offered always by one who wishes for his own welfare. This is especially true in the case of Śrāddha, if a Sāttvika benefit is desired.

## \|\| 1.166.129 \|\|

*idamudyāpanaṃ devi sāvitryāstu vratasya ca \|*  
*sarvapātakaśuddhyarthaṃ kāryaṃ devi naraiḥ sadā \|*  
*akāmataḥ kāmato vā pāpaṃ naśyati tatkṣaṇāt \|\| 129 \|\|*

129\. This is the Udyāpana (valedictory rite) of the Sāvitrī Vrata, O fair lady. It should be performed by men always for the purpose of eliminating all sins. O goddess, whether it is performed with or without a desire for benefit, the sin perishes instantly.

## \|\| 1.166.130 \|\|

*iha loke tu saubhāgyaṃ dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ varāḥ striyaḥ \|*  
*bhavaṃti vividhāsteṣāṃ yairyātrā tatra vai kṛtā \|\| 130 \|\|*

130\. By the people who perform the pilgrimage to the place the following (benefits) is obtained: Good fortune in this world, wealth, food-grains, excellent women etc.

## \|\| 1.166.131 \|\|

*idaṃ yātrāvidhānaṃ tu bhaktyā yaḥ kurute naraḥ \|*  
*śṛṇoti vā sa pāpaistu sarvaireva pramucyate \|\| 131 \|\|*

131\. If a man devoutly performs the pilgrimage or devoutly listens to the rules thereof he shall be rid of all sins.

## \|\| 1.166.132-134 \|\|

*jyeṣṭhasya pūrṇimāyāṃ tu sāvitrīsthalake śubhe \|*  
*pradakṣiṇā yaḥ kurute phaladānairyathāvidhi \|\| 132 \|\|*

*aṣṭottaraśataṃ vāpi tadardhārdhaṃ tadardhakam \|*  
*yaḥ karoti naro devi sṛṣṭvā tatra pradakṣiṇām \|\| 133 \|\|*

*agamyāgamanaṃ yaiśca kṛtaṃ jñānācca mānavaiḥ \|*  
*anyāni pātakānyevaṃ naśyaṃte nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 134 \|\|*

132-134. On the Full-Moon day in the month of Jyeṣṭha the devotee should perform Pradakṣiṇā (circumambulation) along with offerings of fruit at the splendid Sāvitrī-Sthalaka. They may be one hundred-eight, or its half (54) or its half (27). All his sins perish even if they may be very heinous such as Agamyāgamana (carnally approaching prohibited women) committed deliberately. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 1.166.135-136 \|\|

*yairgatvā sthalake saṃdhyā sāvitryāḥ samupāsitā \|*  
*svapatnyāścaiva hastena pāṃḍukūpajalena ca \|\| 135 \|\|*

*bhṛṃgārakanakenaiva mṛnmayenātha bhāmini \|*  
*ānīya tu jalaṃ puṇyaṃ saṃdhyopāstiṃ karoti yaḥ \|*  
*tena dvādaśavarṣāṇi bhavetsaṃdhyā hyupāsitā \|\| 136 \|\|*

135-136. A devotee should make his wife fetch the water from Pāṇḍukūpa and perform Sandhyā rite of Sāvitrī. It may be fetched in a golden pitcher or earthen pot, O fair lady. If the Sandhyā is performed thus it is as good as it is performed for twelve years.

## \|\| 1.166.137 \|\|

*aśvamedhaphalaṃ snāne dāne daśaguṇaṃ tathā \|*  
*upavāse tvanaṃtaṃ ca kathāyāḥ śravaṇe tathā \|\| 137 \|\|*

137\. In the holy bath the benefit is that of a horse-sacrifice. In Dāna the benefit is ten times more. The benefit is unlimited in fast and so in listening to the story.

## Chapter 167 - Greatness of Bhūtamātṛkā (Bhūta-mātṛkā)

## \|\| 1.167.1-2 \|\|

*īśvara uvāca \|*  
*tato gacchenmahādevi tatrasthāṃ bhūtamātṛkām \|*  
*sāvitryā vārūṇe bhāge śatadhanvaṃtare sthitām \|\| 1 \|\|*

*navakoṭi gaṇairyuktāṃ pretabhūtasamākulām \|*  
*pūjitāṃ siddhagaṃdharvairdevādibhiranekaśaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

Īśvara said:

1-2. Thereafter, O great Goddess, a pilgrim should go to the shrine of Bhūtamātṛkā stationed there within a distance of a hundred Dhanus to the west of Sāvitrī.

She is accompanied by nine crores of Gaṇas and is crowded with the company of Pretas and Bhūtas (spirits). She is worshipped in many ways by Siddhas, Gandharvas and other Devas.

## \|\| 1.167.3 \|\|

*devyuvāca \|*  
*bhūtamāteti saṃhṛṣṭā grāmegrāme purepure \|*  
*gāyannṛtyanhasaṃllokaḥ sarvataḥ paridhāvati \|\| 3 \|\|*

The Devī said:

3\. People in a group run about all round singing, dancing and laughing rapturously in every village and town in the name of Bhūta-Mātā.

## \|\| 1.167.4 \|\|

*unmattavatpralapate kṣitau patati mattavat \|*  
*kruddhavaddhāvati parānmṛtavatkṛṣyate hi saḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Like an intoxicated person they prattle and babble and fall on the ground like an inebriated one. They run as though very furious and drag others as though they are corpses.

## \|\| 1.167.5 \|\|

*sukhabhaṃgāṃśca kurute loko vātagṛhītavat \|*  
*bhūtavadbhasmamūtrāṃbukardamānavagāhate \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. People are made unhappy as though suffering from delirium. Like a goblin, they wade through wine and muddy slough of ashes.

## \|\| 1.167.6 \|\|

*kimeṣa śāstranirdiṣṭo mārgaḥ kimuta laukikaḥ \|*  
*muhyate me mano deva tena tvaṃ vaktumarhasi \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Is this way shown by the scriptures or merely customary? O Lord, my mind is confused. Hence it behoves you to clarify.

## \|\| 1.167.7 \|\|

*kathaṃ sā puruṣaiḥ pūjyā prabhāsakṣetravāsibhiḥ \|*  
*kasmāttatra gatā devī kasminkāle samāgatā \|*  
*kasmindine tu māse tu tasyāḥ kāryo mahotsavaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7 How is she to be adored by men residing in Prabhāsa-kṣetra? Why did the Goddess go there? When did she come? On which day and in which month should her great festival be celebrated?”

## \|\| 1.167.8 \|\|

*īśvara uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi yatte kiṃcinmanogatam \|*  
*āstikāḥ śraddadhānāśca bhavantīti matirmama \|\| 8 \|\|*

Īśvara said:

8\. Listen, O Goddess, I shall tell what you have in your mind. It is my opinion that the devout will have faith.

## \|\| 1.167.9 \|\|

*cākṣuṣasyāntare'tīte prāpte vaivasvate'ntare \|*  
*dakṣāpamānātsaṃjātā tadā parvataputrikā \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. After the Cākṣuṣa Manvantara had elapsed and Vaivasvata Manvantara had arrived, the Goddess was born as the daughter of the Mountain as a result of the insult inflicted at her by Dakṣa.

## \|\| 1.167.10 \|\|

*dvāpare tu dvitīye vai dattā tvaṃ parvatena me \|*  
*vivāhe caiva saṃjāte sarvadevamanorame \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. In the second Dvāpara, you were given in marriage to me by the Mountain. The marriage was celebrated delighting all the Devas.

## \|\| 1.167.11 \|\|

*tvayā ca sahitaḥ pūrvaṃ mandare cārukaṃdare \|*  
*akrīḍaṃ ca mudā yukto divyakrīḍanakaiḥ priye \|*  
*pīnonnatanitaṃbena bhrājamānā kuconnatām \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. O my beloved, I joyously sported about in your company in the Mandara mountain having many beautiful caves with divine materials of sport. You appeared lustrous with your plump, protruding breasts and big buttocks.

## \|\| 1.167.12 \|\|

*sitābjavadanāṃ hṛṣṭāṃ dṛṣṭvā'haṃ tvāṃ mahāprabhām \|*  
*dagdhakāmataroḥ kandakaṃdalīmiva niḥsṛtām \|*  
*mahārhaśayanasthāṃ tvāṃ tadā kāmitavānaham \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. You appeared highly delighted and lustrous with a radiant countenance resembling a white lotus. You appeared like a new shoot issuing forth from the tree of the burnt Kandarpa (Kāmadeva). You (of plump protruding breasts and big buttocks) were lying on a rich bed of great value and beauty. So I made love to you.

## \|\| 1.167.13-14 \|\|

*surate tava saṃjātaṃ divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ yadā \|*  
*tadā devi samutthāya nirodhānnirgatā bahiḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*tavodakātsamuttasthau nāryekā gahvarodarā \|*  
*kṛṣṇā karālavadanā piṃgākṣī muktamūrdhajā \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. In the intercourse with you that followed a hundred years according to the reckoning of gods elapsed. Then, O Goddess, there came out due to constriction, from your watery secretion a woman with deep cave-like belly. She was black in colour with a hideous face, tawny eyes and dishevelled hairs.

## \|\| 1.167.15 \|\|

*kapālamālābharaṇā baddhamuṇḍārdhapiṃḍakā \|*  
*khaṭvāṃgakaṃkāladharā ruṇḍamuṃḍakarā śivā \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. She was Śivā with a garland of skulls as her ornament, wearing headless trunks and broken skulls on her head. She held Khaṭvāṅga weapon and skeletons (in her hands). Torsos and skulls were held up in her hands.

## \|\| 1.167.16 \|\|

*dvīpicarmāmbaradharā raṇatkiṃkiṇimekhalā \|*  
*ḍamaḍḍamarukārā ca phetkārapūritāmbarā \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. She was dad in the hide of a tiger. Small bells in her girdle jingled. Ḍamarukas (small drums) were played upon. She filled the sky with her hissing Phetkāra.

## \|\| 1.167.17 \|\|

*tasyāśca pārśvagā anyāstāsāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu \|*  
*sakhyo brāhmaṇarākṣasyastāsāṃ caiva sudarśanāḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. There were other women too at her sides. Listen to their names from me. Their female companions, the Brāhmaṇa-rākṣasīs, were beautiful to look at.

## \|\| 1.167.18 \|\|

*daśakoṭiprabhedena dharāṃ vyāpya susaṃsthitāḥ \|*  
*mukhyāstatra catasro vai mahābalaparākramāḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. They pervaded the entire earth. They had ten crores of varieties among them and were well-established. Four among them were the chief ones. They possessed great strength and valour.

## \|\| 1.167.19 \|\|

*raktavarṇā mahājihvā'kṣayā vai pāpakāriṇī \|*  
*etāsāmanvaye jātāḥ pṛthivyāṃ brahmarākṣasāḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. They are: (1) Raktavarṇā, (2) Mahājihvā, (3) Akṣayā, and (4) Pāpakāriṇī. All the Brahma-Rākṣasas over the earth are born in the families of these.

## \|\| 1.167.20 \|\|

*śleṣmātakatarau hyete prāyaśaḥ sukṛtālayāḥ \|*  
*uttālatālacapalā nṛtyaṃti ca hasaṃti ca \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Generally these have their comfortable residence on Śleṣmātaka trees. They are fickle like moving, lofty palm trees. They dance and laugh.

## \|\| 1.167.21 \|\|

*vijñeyā iha loke'sminbhūtānāṃ mūlanāyakāḥ \|*  
*atikṛṣṇā bhavantyete vyaṃtarāntaracāriṇaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. They should be known as the original leaders of she spirits in this world. They are extremely dark-complexioned. These spirits move about in the space.
